rules.name: Corbett archery
rules.bag: Area daily limit 1 deer; area annual limit 2 across all seasons. Statewide annual 5 (maximum 2 antlerless) and possession 4 also apply.
rules.licenses: Hunting license, management area permit and deer permit unless exempt; no quota permit required. Archery season permit unless exempt.
rules.methods: Bows only; crossbows, airbows and draw-lock bows prohibited except qualifying disability permits.
